units.source_text: 古歌云：‘安得年光如轮转，夙昔之日今再来。’

en.t: An old poem says: 'If only the years could turn like a wheel, and the days long past could come again today.'

units.source_text: 明知言之无益，但渴望其能再来。”

en.t: Though I know it is useless to say so, I still long for them to return."

units.source_text: 言词亲切，仿佛两人已有深交。

en.t: The words were intimate, as though the two already shared a deep friendship.

units.source_text: 诗用一张浅绿色的中国纸写，挂在白布上，

en.t: The poem was written on a sheet of pale green Chinese paper and hung on white cloth,

units.source_text: 白布系在杨桐枝上，表示是供奉神明的。

en.t: and the white cloth was tied to a branch of sacred cleyera, showing that it was an offering to the gods.

units.source_text: 中将便写回信：“离群索居，寂寞无聊；

en.t: The Captain then wrote a reply: "Living apart from others in solitude, I am lonely and weary;
as I brood over the past, many distant thoughts arise.
Yet there is still nothing I can do."
He wrote it with even greater care than usual.

units.source_text: 斋院则在白布上题一首诗：

en.t: The Kamo Priestess, for her part, inscribed a poem on the white cloth:
